title: jasminum abyssinicum var. gratissimum
intro: Jasminum abyssinicum var. gratissimum, commonly known as Night-scented Jasmine, is a flowering plant native to tropical Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Night-scented Jasmine are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that have been shown to have sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system.
